# Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.131

[![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_on_Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/utkiduck)

![Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.131 release poster](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/releases/download/v0.0.131/FightingForceRecharged-0.0.131-Poster.png)

Combat focus and optional aiming guides for the original Windows version of
**Fighting Force (1997)**. This update builds on the widescreen, modern controls,
independent cameras, first-person view, dynamic co-op and campaign saves from
0.0.130.

## New in this version

- **Target focus:** lock a visible enemy, track it with the camera and switch
  targets deliberately. Each cooperative player owns a separate target;
  focusing requests independent views in dynamic split screen. Dead or
  persistently hidden targets release focus without automatic retargeting.
- **Pose-following target marker:** short outlined corners frame the selected
  enemy's current pose, including lying enemies. Hide the marker independently
  while keeping target focus active.
- **First-person weapon laser:** a barrel-mounted guide follows pistols and
  the shotgun, including lowered movement poses and intermediate 60 FPS frames.
  Blue means ammunition remains; red means empty. The dot indicates a predicted
  visual obstruction.
- **Throw trajectory:** a dashed flight guide and first-contact ring for
  grenades and heavy throw-only items in first or third person. It uses native
  throw speed, gravity and drag, with separate ownership for co-op players.
- **Gameplay Settings:** Player Block now shares an Options submenu with
  Target Focus, Target Marker, Weapon Laser and Throw Trajectory. Save and Back
  applies the draft; Cancel keeps the previous settings. The new combat guide
  is included in both setup and the Windows archive.

## Default controls

| Action | Keyboard and mouse | Xbox / XInput |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Toggle target focus; recenter if no target is available | Middle mouse | R3 |
| Previous / next target while focused | Z / C | Flick right stick left / right |
| First-person / third-person view | Tab | L3 |

The Focus/Recenter and keyboard target-switch actions can be remapped in
**Options > Controller Settings**. Disable **Target Focus** in
**Options > Gameplay Settings** to restore unconditional recentering.
The three visual guides have independent switches and default to ON.
Player Block remains optional and OFF by default; enable it in Gameplay
Settings, then hold **Q / LB** with default bindings.

## Install or update

1. Extract **FightingForceRecharged-0.0.131-Windows.zip**.
2. Run **FightingForceSetup.exe**.
3. For an existing installation, select **Add fix to existing game folder**
   and choose the folder containing **fforce.exe**. For a new retail install,
   select **Install game from original disc**.
4. Start **fforce.exe** from that game folder.

Close the game before updating. Setup preserves existing wrapper settings,
campaign saves and original game files. Back up personal settings and saves
before moving an installation. New settings use their defaults when absent
from an existing configuration.

Requires **Windows 10/11 x64** and the supported **English PC retail or reviewed
English RIP** executable. Setup requires a supported executable and nonempty
main game data; the complete reference inventory is an optional diagnostic.
The retail version needs its original mounted disc. The reviewed RIP retains
its supplied missing intro/music; mounted original audio media can supply music.
This patch targets the original PC game, not an emulated console edition.

Original executables, libraries and assets remain unchanged on disk. No game
files, disc images, movies or music are included or downloaded by setup.

## Behavior and coverage limits

- Target focus and the aiming previews require the independent gameplay
  camera. Original Shared co-op retains its existing behavior.
- Native attack, damage, recovery and firing rules remain in charge. Looking
  up or down does not change the original horizontal firearm shot height.
  The laser follows the current barrel; a firing animation can raise the gun.
- Aiming contacts use captured opaque scenery and approximate actor bounds.
  The throw guide starts at the current held pose, so the release animation
  can move its origin. Bounces, rolling, grenade fuse timing and blast radius
  are not predicted.
- Cameras, dynamic split screen and interpolated rendering remain experimental.
  Full-campaign geometry and extended two-controller coverage remain incomplete.
  Campaign saves restore level entry, not an arbitrary mid-fight state.

The release pipeline builds the exact source revision, runs deterministic
runtime and installer checks, audits package contents and verifies archive
checksums. **release.json** records the source revision and artifact hashes;
**SHA256SUMS.txt** provides download checksums. **Source.zip** contains project
source, not the game. The installer and wrapper are not code-signed.

See the [quick start](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.131/docs/QUICKSTART.md),
[combat guide](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.131/docs/COMBAT-FOCUS.md)
and [tested media](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/blob/v0.0.131/docs/VALIDATION.md#tested-media-and-source).
